candidate: Key Point St Petersburg / SPB DC2
adjudication: The operator's June 16 Telegram post describes the project as already in active implementation after reporting a presentation about its construction. This is contextual support for project progress but does not distinguish physical site work from design, procurement or administrative implementation.

The June 23 company report describes the same June 16 forum. The publication date is not a new June 23 construction-site observation. The report says the speakers discussed construction, without unambiguously asserting current physical works.

The July 9 contractor-hosted CEO interview says the company is currently implementing the large St Petersburg project in a construction-services discussion. Neither an exact interview date nor current physical works are specified. Publication does not establish the interview's observation day.

The current operator project page's under-construction label is undated. The older November 2025 construction-start announcement cannot alone supply the fixed May 22-August 20 physical observation. A dated permit establishes authorization, not actual work.

An independent second reviewer read all three dated source bodies and agreed that the physical-work gate remains unresolved. This review does not require a specific trade milestone: an unambiguous authoritative dated statement of ongoing physical construction would suffice.

The separately researched operator address and map point can close location independently, but cannot cure the lifecycle hold. No campus, phase, capacity, role, imagery result or certification is accepted here.
